## Task

Show that reduction preserves typing and that a closed well-typed term can step or is a value in the dependent dependency calculus.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `Typing_preservation`
- `Typing_progress`

      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Eq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_SSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_SSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Eq_SumFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A1' A2 A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A1'
 | Eq_SumSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A2 A2' A1 A1':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2'
 | Eq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Eq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Eq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a a' ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     DefEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | Eq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Eq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Eq_SubstIrrel : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (b1 a1 b2 a2:tm) (psi:grade),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      True  ->
      True  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  phi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      not (  (  ( psi  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
     DefEq P phi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a2 ) .

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_AppIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_WPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_WPairIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
| T_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a c C B A:tm) (s:sort),
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
               Typing ((x ~ (q_C, a_WSigma psi0 A B)) ++ meet_ctx_l q_C W) q_C (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x)) (a_Type s))  ->
       Typing W psi a (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
         forall y,  y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
               Typing ((x ~ ((q_join psi0 psi), A)) ++ W) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x))
                    (a_Pi q_Bot (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                           (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_WPair (a_Var_f x) psi0 (a_Var_f y)))))) ->
       (Typing W psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)  (open_tm_wrt_tm C a))
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_Sum : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Sum A B) (a_Type s)
 | T_Inj1 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a1 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a1 A1 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_Inj2 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a2 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a2 A2 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Sum A1 A2)
| T_Case : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 B:tm) (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm) s,
       ( forall z, z \notin    L ->  Typing  (  (  ( z ~(  q_C  , (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++  (  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )  )  )   q_C  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) (a_Type s)) ->
     Typing W psi a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f y) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f y)) )    )  ->
     Typing W psi b1 (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) ->
     Typing W psi b2 (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit.

Inductive CTyping : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CT_Leq : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a A ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A
 | CT_Top : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W ) .

Inductive ValueType : tm -> Prop :=
 | ValueType_Type : forall (s:sort),
     ValueType (a_Type s)
 | ValueType_Unit :
     ValueType a_TyUnit
 | ValueType_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_Pi psi A B)
 | ValueType_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_WSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_SSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_Sum : forall (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     ValueType (a_Sum A B).

Inductive Consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Consistent_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     Consistent (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Consistent_a_Unit :
     Consistent a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Consistent_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Pi psi A B) )   ( (a_Pi psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_WSigma psi A B) )   ( (a_WSigma psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  (a_SSigma psi A B)   (a_SSigma psi A' B')
 | Consistent_a_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm B' ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Sum A B) )   ( (a_Sum A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_Step_R : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( ValueType a )  ->
     Consistent a b
 | Consistent_a_Step_L : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not ( ValueType b )  ->
     Consistent a b.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Par P psi a a
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CPar P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_WPairBeta : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 b2 a1' a2':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_WPair a1' psi0 a2') ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a1' )   q_Bot  a2')
 | Par_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a1' a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) a1'
 | Par_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) a2
 | Par_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     Par P psi A1 A1' ->
     Par P psi A2 A2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Par_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 a1' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Par_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     Par P psi a2 a2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Par_CaseBeta1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b1' a' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj1 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b1' psi0 a')
 | Par_CaseBeta2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b2' a' b1':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b2' psi0 a')
 | Par_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2').

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     MultiPar P psi a a
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b1 b2:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b1 ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive Value : tm -> Prop :=
 | V_ValueType : forall (a:tm),
     ValueType a ->
     Value a
 | V_TmUnit :
     Value a_TmUnit
 | V_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     Value (a_Abs psi A a)
 | V_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_WPair a psi b)
 | V_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_SPair a psi b)
 | V_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj1 a)
 | V_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj2 a).

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export Qual.grade_sig.

Require Export Qual.sort_sig.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Definition grade : Set := grade.

Definition sort : Set := sort.

Inductive tm : Set :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Sum (A1:tm) (A2:tm)
 | a_Inj1 (a:tm)
 | a_Inj2 (a:tm)
 | a_Case (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b1:tm) (b2:tm)
 | a_WSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_WPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_LetPair (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm).

Definition econtext : Set := list ( atom * grade ).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_Sum : forall (A1 A2:tm),
     (lc_tm A1) ->
     (lc_tm A2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sum A1 A2))
 | lc_a_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj1 a))
 | lc_a_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj2 a))
 | lc_a_Case : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm b2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Case psi a b1 b2))
 | lc_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_WPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_LetPair : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
 | lc_a_Proj2 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj2 psi a)).

Fixpoint fv_tm_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => (fv_tm_tm A1) \u (fv_tm_tm A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b1) \u (fv_tm_tm b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
end.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm_tm a x A))).

Definition join_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi * g, A)).

Definition join_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g * psi, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi + g, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g + psi, A)).

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Type s => a_Type s
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b) ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)
 | S_LetPairBeta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a1 )   q_Bot  a2).

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* Opening and closing remove and insert one de Bruijn index, respectively. *)
Fixpoint scoped (k : nat) (t : tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_Var_b n => (n < k)%nat
  | a_Pi _ a b | a_Abs _ a b | a_WSigma _ a b
  | a_SSigma _ a b | a_LetPair _ a b => scoped k a /\\ scoped (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b | a_WPair a _ b | a_SPair a _ b
  | a_Sum a b => scoped k a /\\ scoped k b
  | a_Case _ a b c => scoped k a /\\ scoped k b /\\ scoped k c
  | a_Inj1 a | a_Inj2 a | a_Proj1 _ a | a_Proj2 _ a => scoped k a
  | _ => True
  end.

Local Ltac indices :=
  repeat match goal with
  | |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] => destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]
  | H : context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?n ?k] |- _ =>
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]
  | |- context [lt_ge_dec ?n ?k] => destruct (lt_ge_dec n k)
  | H : context [lt_ge_dec ?n ?k] |- _ => destruct (lt_ge_dec n k)
  end.

Lemma scoped_mono : forall t k j, scoped k t -> (k <= j)%nat -> scoped j t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; intros; intuition eauto; try lia;
    eauto using Nat.succ_le_mono.
Qed.

Lemma open_scoped_id : forall t k u, scoped k t -> open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; intros; intuition; try (f_equal; eauto).
  indices; try lia; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma scoped_open_var : forall t k x,
  scoped k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f x) t) <-> scoped (S k) t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; intros; try (repeat rewrite <- ?IHt, <- ?IHt1, <- ?IHt2, <- ?IHt3 at 2; tauto);
    try (rewrite ?IHt, ?IHt1, ?IHt2, ?IHt3; tauto).

(* A lambda calculus with inert constants, used to distinguish type heads. *)
Inductive head :=
| h_Type (s : sort) | h_Unit | h_Pi (g : grade)
| h_WSigma (g : grade) | h_SSigma (g : grade) | h_Sum | h_Dummy.

Inductive raw :=
| rBound (n : nat) | rFree (x : atom) | rHead (h : head)
| rLam (b : raw) | rApp (f a : raw).

Definition lift_ren (f : nat -> nat) n :=
  match n with 0 => 0 | S n => S (f n) end.

Fixpoint ren (f : nat -> nat) (t : raw) : raw :=
  match t with
  | rBound n => rBound (f n)
  | rLam b => rLam (ren (lift_ren f) b)
  | rApp a b => rApp (ren f a) (ren f b)
  | _ => t
  end.

Definition lift_inst (f : (nat + atom)%type -> raw) (x : (nat + atom)%type) : raw :=
  match x with
  | inl 0 => rBound 0
  | inl (S n) => ren S (f (inl n))
  | inr a => ren S (f (inr a))
  end.

Fixpoint inst (f : (nat + atom)%type -> raw) (t : raw) : raw :=
  match t with
  | rBound n => f (inl n)
  | rFree a => f (inr a)
  | rLam b => rLam (inst (lift_inst f) b)
  | rApp a b => rApp (inst f a) (inst f b)
  | rHead _ => t
  end.

Definition rid (x : (nat + atom)%type) :=
  match x with inl n => rBound n | inr a => rFree a end.
Definition slot (u : raw) (x : (nat + atom)%type) :=
  match x with inl 0 => u | inl (S n) => rBound n | inr a => rFree a end.
Definition rb (t u : raw) := inst (slot u) t.

Lemma ren_ext : forall t f g, (forall n, f n = g n) -> ren f t = ren g t.
Proof. intro t; induction t; cbn; intros; f_equal; eauto.
  apply IHt; intros []; cbn; congruence.
Qed.

Lemma ren_comp : forall t f g, ren g (ren f t) = ren (fun n => g (f n)) t.
Proof.
  intro t; induction t; cbn; intros; rewrite ?IHt, ?IHt1, ?IHt2; try reflexivity.
  f_equal; apply ren_ext; intros []; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma inst_ext : forall t f g, (forall x, f x = g x) -> inst f t = inst g t.
Proof.
  intro t; induction t; cbn; intros; f_equal; eauto.
  apply IHt; intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; congruence.
Qed.

Definition on_bound (f : nat -> nat) (x : (nat + atom)%type) :=
  match x with inl n => inl (f n) | inr a => inr a end.

Lemma inst_ren : forall t f g, inst g (ren f t) = inst (fun x => g (on_bound f x)) t.
Proof.
  intro t; induction t; cbn; intros; rewrite ?IHt, ?IHt1, ?IHt2; try reflexivity.
  f_equal; apply inst_ext; intros [[|n]|x]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ren_inst : forall t f g, ren g (inst f t) = inst (fun x => ren g (f x)) t.
Proof.
  intro t; induction t; cbn; intros; rewrite ?IHt, ?IHt1, ?IHt2; try reflexivity.
  f_equal; apply inst_ext; intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; rewrite ?ren_comp; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma inst_comp : forall t f g, inst g (inst f t) = inst (fun x => inst g (f x)) t.
Proof.
  intro t; induction t; cbn; intros; rewrite ?IHt, ?IHt1, ?IHt2; try reflexivity.
  f_equal; apply inst_ext; intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; try reflexivity;
    rewrite inst_ren, ren_inst; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma inst_id : forall t, inst rid t = t.
Proof.
  intro t; induction t; cbn; rewrite ?IHt1, ?IHt2; try reflexivity.
  f_equal; rewrite <- IHt at 2; apply inst_ext; intros [[|n]|x]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rb_inst : forall t u f, inst f (rb t u) = rb (inst (lift_inst f) t) (inst f u).
Proof.
  intros; unfold rb; rewrite "'!inst_comp; apply inst_ext.
  intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; try reflexivity;
    rewrite inst_ren; apply inst_id.
Qed.

Inductive rpar : raw -> raw -> Prop :=
| rp_bound : forall n, rpar (rBound n) (rBound n)
| rp_free : forall x, rpar (rFree x) (rFree x)
| rp_head : forall h, rpar (rHead h) (rHead h)
| rp_lam : forall a b, rpar a b -> rpar (rLam a) (rLam b)
| rp_app : forall a b c d, rpar a c -> rpar b d -> rpar (rApp a b) (rApp c d)
| rp_beta : forall a b c d, rpar a c -> rpar b d -> rpar (rApp (rLam a) b) (rb c d).

Lemma rpar_refl : forall a, rpar a a.
Proof. intro a; induction a; auto with raw. Qed.
Local Hint Resolve rpar_refl : raw.

Lemma rpar_ren : forall a b, rpar a b -> forall f, rpar (ren f a) (ren f b).
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; intros; auto with raw.
  change (rpar (rApp (rLam (ren (lift_ren f) a)) (ren f b))
    (inst (fun x => ren f (slot d x)) c)).
  { unfold rb in *; rewrite ren_inst; reflexivity. }
Qed.

Definition rdummy := rHead h_Dummy.
Definition rpair := rLam (rLam (rLam (rApp (rApp (rBound 0) (rBound 2)) (rBound 1)))).
Definition rinj1 := rLam (rLam (rLam (rApp (rBound 1) (rBound 2)))).
Definition rinj2 := rLam (rLam (rLam (rApp (rBound 0) (rBound 2)))).
Definition rfst := rLam (rLam (rBound 1)).
Definition rsnd := rLam (rLam (rBound 0)).
Definition visible (p q : grade) (a : raw) := if q <=? p then a else rdummy.

Fixpoint encode (p : grade) (t : tm) : raw :=
  match t with
  | a_Var_b n => rBound n
  | a_Var_f x => rFree x
  | a_Type s => rHead (h_Type s)
  | a_TyUnit => rHead h_Unit
  | a_TmUnit => rdummy
  | a_Abs _ _ b => rLam (encode p b)
  | a_App f q a => rApp (encode p f) (visible p q (encode p a))
  | a_WPair a q b | a_SPair a q b =>
      rApp (rApp rpair (visible p q (encode p a))) (encode p b)
  | a_Proj1 _ a => rApp (encode p a) rfst
  | a_Proj2 _ a => rApp (encode p a) rsnd
  | a_LetPair _ a b => rApp (encode p a) (rLam (encode p b))
  | a_Inj1 a => rApp rinj1 (encode p a)
  | a_Inj2 a => rApp rinj2 (encode p a)
  | a_Case _ a b c => rApp (rApp (encode p a) (encode p b)) (encode p c)
  | a_Sum a b => rnode h_Sum (encode p a) (encode p b)
  | a_Pi q a b => rnode (h_Pi q) (encode p a) (rLam (encode p b))
  | a_WSigma q a b => rnode (h_WSigma q) (encode p a) (rLam (encode p b))
  | a_SSigma q a b => rnode (h_SSigma q) (encode p a) (rLam (encode p b))
  end.

Definition under (P : (nat + atom)%type -> Prop) (x : (nat + atom)%type) :=
  match x with inl 0 => True | inl (S n) => P (inl n) | inr a => P (inr a) end.

Fixpoint support (P : (nat + atom)%type -> Prop) (a : raw) : Prop :=
  match a with
  | rBound n => P (inl n)
  | rFree x => P (inr x)
  | rLam b => support (under P) b
  | rApp b c => support P b /\\ support P c
  | _ => True
  end.

Lemma support_mono : forall a P Q, support P a ->
  (forall x, P x -> Q x) -> support Q a.
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; intuition eauto.
  eapply IHa; [eassumption|intros [[|n]|x]; simpl; eauto].
Qed.

Lemma support_inst : forall a P f g, support P a ->
  (forall x, P x -> f x = g x) -> inst f a = inst g a.
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; cbn; intros; try tauto; try solve [f_equal; intuition eauto].
  f_equal; eapply IHa; [eassumption|].
  intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; intros; f_equal; auto.
Qed.

Lemma support_ren : forall a P Q f, support P a ->
  (forall x, P x -> Q (on_bound f x)) -> support Q (ren f a).
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; intuition eauto.
  eapply IHa; [eassumption|intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; auto].
Qed.

Lemma support_substitution : forall a P Q f, support P a ->
  (forall x, P x -> support Q (f x)) -> support Q (inst f a).
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; intuition eauto.
  eapply IHa; [eassumption|].
  intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; intros; auto;
    eapply support_ren; [eauto|intros [i|y]; auto].
Qed.

Definition raw_scope k (x : (nat + atom)%type) :=
  match x with inl n => (n < k)%nat | _ => True end.
Definition raw_fresh (x : atom) (v : (nat + atom)%type) :=
  match v with inl _ => True | inr y => y <> x end.

Lemma support_scope_under : forall k x, raw_scope (S k) x -> under (raw_scope k) x.
Proof. intros ? [[|n]|x]; cbn; intuition lia. Qed.
Lemma support_fresh_under : forall a x, support (raw_fresh x) a -> support (under (raw_fresh x)) a.
Proof. intros; eapply support_mono; eauto; intros [[|n]|y]; cbn; auto. Qed.

Local Ltac visibility := repeat match goal with |- context [visible ?p ?q ?a] =>
  unfold visible; destruct (q <=? p)
end.

Lemma encode_scope : forall a p k, scoped k a -> support (raw_scope k) (encode p a).
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; visibility; cbn in *;
    repeat split; intuition (eauto; try lia);
    eapply support_mono; [eauto|apply support_scope_under].
Qed.

Lemma encode_fresh : forall a p x, x \\notin fv_tm_tm a -> support (raw_fresh x) (encode p a).
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; visibility; cbn in *;
    repeat split; try solve
    [eauto using support_fresh_under with fsetdec | intro; subst; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma scoped_ren_S : forall a, support (raw_scope 0) a -> ren S a = a.
Proof.
  assert (H : forall a k (f : nat -> nat), support (raw_scope k) a ->
    (forall n, (n < k)%nat -> f n = n) -> ren f a = a).
  { intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; try solve [f_equal; intuition eauto].
    f_equal; eapply IHa.
    - eapply support_mono; [eassumption|]. intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; intuition lia.
    - intros [|n]; cbn; intros; f_equal; auto with arith.
  }
  intros; eapply H; eauto; intros; lia.
Qed.

  match k with 0 => slot u | S k => lift_inst (at_depth k u) end.

Lemma at_depth_free : forall k u x, at_depth k u (inr x) = rFree x.
Proof. induction k; simpl; intros; rewrite ?IHk; reflexivity. Qed.

  at_depth k u (inl n) =
  match lt_eq_lt_dec n k with
  | inleft (left _) => rBound n
  | inleft (right _) => u
  | inright _ => rBound (n - 1)
  end.
Proof.
  induction k; intros u [|n] H; try reflexivity.
  simpl; rewrite IHk by auto.
  indices; try reflexivity; rewrite scoped_ren_S by auto; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma encode_open_rec : forall a p k u, scoped 0 u ->
  encode p (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u a) =
  inst (at_depth k (encode p u)) (encode p a).
Proof.
  intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; unfold rnode; visibility; cbn;

  - rewrite at_depth_bound by auto using encode_scope.

  - rewrite at_depth_free; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma encode_open : forall a p u, lc_tm u ->
  encode p (open_tm_wrt_tm a u) = rb (encode p a) (encode p u).
Proof. intros; apply encode_open_rec; auto using lc_scoped. Qed.

  - assert (hn : ~ q <= p) by (change (~ (q <=? p) = true); congruence).

  - auto with raw.

Lemma encoded_eq_closed : forall P p a, support (raw_scope 0) a ->
  (forall x, support (raw_fresh x) a) -> encoded_eq P p a a.
Proof.
  intros; apply encoded_eq_refl.
  (* Every variable in such a term is locally bound. *)
  assert (J : forall a (U : (nat + atom)%type -> Prop) k,
    (forall n, (n < k)%nat -> U (inl n)) ->
    support (raw_scope k) a -> (forall x, support (raw_fresh x) a) -> support U a).
  { intro a; induction a; simpl; intros; intuition eauto.
    - specialize (H1 x); cbn in H1; contradiction.
    - eapply IHa; [intros [|n] Hn; cbn; auto with arith| |].
      + eapply support_mono; [eassumption|intros [[|n]|x]; cbn; intuition lia].
      + intro x; eapply support_mono; [apply H1|].
        intros [[|n]|y]; cbn; auto.

  eapply J; eauto; intros; lia.
Qed.

Lemma defequality_encode :

  (forall P p a b, DefEq P p a b -> encoded_eq P p (encode p a) (encode p b)).
Proof.
  apply defequality_ind; intros; cbn [encode rnode];
    try rewrite "'!visible_yes by assumption; try rewrite !visible_no by assumption;
    try solve [eauto using grade_support with raw];
    try solve [repeat apply encoded_eq_app; eauto with raw;
       apply encoded_eq_refl; cbn [support rpair rinj1 rinj2 rfst rsnd rdummy under]; tauto].

  - unfold encoded_eq in *; intuition eauto using rconv_sym.
  - unfold encoded_eq; eauto using grade_support, step_encode.
  - apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - eapply encoded_eq_open; eauto.
    apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - eapply encoded_eq_open; eauto using grade_support with raw.
    apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - eapply encoded_eq_open; eauto.
    apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - apply encoded_eq_node in H0; tauto.
  - (* Irrelevant substitution can put any locally closed term in the omitted slot. *)
    assert (Ea : support (usable P phi) (encode phi b1)).
    { eapply binder_irrel; [eassumption|].
      intros; match goal with H : forall x, _ -> encoded_eq _ _ _ _ |- _ =>

    assert (Eb : support (usable P phi) (encode phi b2)).
    { eapply binder_irrel; [eassumption|].
      intros; match goal with H : forall x, _ -> encoded_eq _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
        exact (proj1 (proj2 (H x ltac:(assumption)))) end. }
    rewrite !encode_open by assumption; rewrite !(@rb_irrel P phi) by assumption.
    unfold encoded_eq; repeat split; auto.
    eapply encode_binder_conv; intros; match goal with
    | H : forall x, _ -> encoded_eq _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
        exact (proj2 (proj2 (H x ltac:(assumption))))

Qed.

  rconv (encode p a) (encode p b).
Proof. intros; exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 defequality_encode _ _ _ _ H))). Qed.

Proof. intros; eapply (proj2 defequality_transport); eauto. Qed.

Lemma join_bot : forall p, p * q_Bot = p.
Proof. intros; rewrite join_comm; apply join_leq, bot_le. Qed.

Lemma join_top : forall p, p <= q_Top.
Proof. intro; apply leq_join, join_Top_r. Qed.

Lemma grade_antisym : forall p q, p <= q -> q <= p -> p = q.
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma join_mono : forall a b c, a <= b -> a * c <= b * c.
Proof. intros; apply join_bound; eauto with ddc. Qed.

Lemma meet_id : forall W, meet_ctx_l q_C (meet_ctx_l q_C W) = meet_ctx_l q_C W.
Proof.
  intro W; induction W as [|[x [p A]] W IH]; cbn; auto.
  unfold meet_ctx_l in *; cbn; rewrite IH, meet_assoc, meet_idem; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma meet_bind : forall W x p A, binds x (p,A) W ->
  binds x (q_C + p,A) (meet_ctx_l q_C W).
Proof.
  intros; apply (binds_map _ _ (fun '(p,A) => (q_C + p,A)) _ _ _ H).
Qed.

Lemma labels_bind : forall W x p A, binds x (p,A) W -> binds x p (labels W).
Proof.
  intros; apply (binds_map _ _ (fun '(p,A) => p) _ _ _ H).
Qed.

Lemma meet_bind_inv : forall W x r A, binds x (r,A) (meet_ctx_l q_C W) ->
  exists p, binds x (p,A) W /\\ r = q_C + p.
Proof.
  induction W as [|[y [p B]] W IH]; cbn; intros x r A H.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct H as [H|H].
    + inversion H; subst; eauto.
    + destruct (IH _ _ _ H) as [q [Hq ->]]; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma labels_bind_inv : forall W x p, binds x p (labels W) ->
  exists A, binds x (p,A) W.
Proof.
  induction W as [|[y [q A]] W IH]; cbn; intros x p H.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct H as [H|H].
    + inversion H; subst; eauto.
    + destruct (IH _ _ H); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_meet : forall W, dom (meet_ctx_l q_C W) [=] dom W.
Proof. intro; apply dom_map. Qed.
Lemma dom_labels : forall W, dom (labels W) [=] dom W.
Proof. intro; apply dom_map. Qed.
Lemma uniq_meet : forall W, uniq W -> uniq (meet_ctx_l q_C W).
Proof. intros; apply uniq_map; assumption. Qed.
Lemma uniq_labels : forall W, uniq W -> uniq (labels W).
Proof. intros; apply uniq_map; assumption. Qed.
Lemma ctx_uniq : forall W, Ctx W -> uniq W.
Proof. induction 1; auto using uniq_nil, uniq_cons. Qed.

  uniq V /\\ forall x p A, binds x (p,A) W ->
    exists q, binds x (q,A) V /\\ q <= p * d.

  x \\notin dom V -> q <= p * d -> ctx_map d ((x,(p,A))::W) ((x,(q,A))::V).
Proof.
  intros d W V x p q A [H J] Fx Hq; split; [apply uniq_cons; auto|].
  intros y r B [E|E].
  - inversion E; subst; exists q; split; simpl; auto.
  - destruct (J _ _ _ E) as [s [F G]]; exists s; split; simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_map_meet : forall d W V, ctx_map d W V ->
  ctx_map d (meet_ctx_l q_C W) (meet_ctx_l q_C V).
Proof.
  intros d W V [H J]; split; auto using uniq_meet.
  intros x p A E; destruct (meet_bind_inv E) as [r [F ->]].
  destruct (J _ _ _ F) as [q [G Hq]].
  exists (q_C + q); split; auto using meet_bind.
  destruct (order_q_C_dec r) as [R|[R _]].
  - rewrite meet_cap by assumption; eauto with ddc.
  - rewrite (meet_leq _ _ R); eauto with ddc.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_map_permits : forall d W V, ctx_map d W V ->
  permits (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C W)) (labels (meet_ctx_l q_C V)) q_C.
Proof.
  intros d W V [H J]; split; auto using uniq_meet, uniq_labels.
  intros x p E _.
  destruct (labels_bind_inv E) as [A F].
  destruct (meet_bind_inv F) as [r [G ->]].
  destruct (J _ _ _ G) as [q [B _]].
  exists (q_C + q); auto using labels_bind, meet_bind, meet_left.
Qed.

Proof.

  unfold meet_ctx_l in *; cbn; rewrite IH, meet_comm, meet_leq by apply join_top.
